title: Tic Tac unloaded from a C-130 in the Azores
summary: UAPGerb tells of Tic Tac unloaded from a C-130 in the Azores, about unspecified at Azores, Portugal, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

plain: A guest known as UAPGerb, speaking on host Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025, mentions a person stationed with the US Air Force in the Azores, Portuguese islands in the Atlantic. According to UAPGerb, this person claims to have seen a Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, unloaded from a C-130, a large military cargo plane, which would mean the military has such an object in hand.
